c.title: $4,200 / 2br - 954ft2 - 2 Bedroom-954 ft2-2 bed Spacious 2 bath w/AC Unit 3302 Downtown (Alberni Street, Vancouver)
c.description:
One year minimum lease offered for this unfurnished upgraded large 2 bed, 2 bathroom suite (unit #3302) located on a residential floor of the boutique Carmana Hotel & Suites. Take advantage of the hotel amenities such as the fitness room (including peloton bikes), bike storage lockers, underground gated parking, a conference room and concierge service. Look out your floor to ceiling living room window to see the views of downtown Vancouver and the north shore mountain.

Come by 1128 Alberni Street between 9am - 8pm , seven days a week, and our front office can assist in showing you your new home. For virtual viewings, please email show contact info to coordinate a time or call us at show contact info to ask any questions. Note that the pictures in the ad do not necessarily represent the suite that is available, please arrange a viewing to see current availability. This unit for unfurnished rental.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Located along Downtown Vancouver’s luxury row and one block north of Robson Street, Carmana Hotel & Suites is set in one of the most coveted areas in town, offering front door access to the financial and business districts, a gourmet grocery across the street, and a diverse selection of cafés and restaurants nearby. Strategically located at the intersection of Alberni and Thurlow Streets and being just a short walk away from the Burrard Sky Train station, the building is the ideal hub to transit in and out of the downtown core.


****************************************************************************
For more information, please visit https://www.carmanahotel.com/
****************************************************************************
